01 / The business case

Paper still costs more than you think.

Traditional registration books create friction at arrival and trap useful operational and commercial information in physical pages.

01 · SERVE

How much time is spent on manual administration?

Repeated data entry and paper forms consume front-of-house time that could be spent welcoming guests.

02 · UNDERSTAND

How well do you know your guests?

Guest origin, travel patterns and preferences can be difficult to analyse when information stays in physical registers.

03 · GROW

Can you see room and occupancy patterns?

Clearer performance information can help management investigate room utilisation, demand peaks and promotional opportunities.

FastCheckIn perspective: Digital check-in is the entry point. The broader value is making guest information easier to access and use for service, market analysis and management decisions.

02 / Why FastCheckIn

One platform connecting guest experience with commercial performance.

Our proposition is built around three connected outcomes: Serve, Understand and Grow.

SERVE

Better arrivals & service

Digital check-in on a property tablet or guest mobile via QR/link, ID capture, digital signatures and indemnities, returning-guest convenience, and relevant guest preferences.

UNDERSTAND

Guest & market clarity

Explore guest origins from world to continent, country, region and city. Review guest profiles, stay history and market patterns from recorded information.

GROW

Smarter commercial decisions

Business Snapshot reporting brings occupancy, room-night performance and unit-level utilisation together to inform pricing, promotion and packaging decisions.

FastCheckIn provides information to support decisions; it does not guarantee higher revenue or automatically make management decisions.

03 / Guest experience & records

A seamless arrival that works for guests and your team.

Give guests a digital route to complete registration and make relevant information easier for authorised staff to retrieve.

  • QR- or link-based pre-arrival registration
  • ID/passport capture and digital signatures
  • Digital indemnity forms and stored stay records
  • Centralised guest profiles and stay history
  • Dietary requirements, preferences and consent flags
  • Returning guests can confirm or update existing details
12-language experience: Afrikaans, German, English, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Arabic and Hebrew, as described in the current platform overview.

04 / Market intelligence

See where your guests come from — and what to do about it.

The Visitor Origin Explorer is designed to turn registration address data into a clearer view of the markets a property attracts.

  • Explore world → continent → country → region → city
  • Review domestic and international visitor mix
  • Look for changes and patterns over time
  • Use observed patterns to inform campaigns and seasonal packages

From insight to action

Possible insightQuestion to consider
More visitors from a particular countryWould a targeted campaign or seasonal offer fit this market?
Strong domestic weekend staysCould a weekday offer attract local visitors outside peak periods?
Returning guests from a regionWould a relevant repeat-visit offer be worthwhile?
One market relies heavily on OTAsShould direct-booking incentives be tested?

These are illustrative management ideas, not claims that the software automatically recommends these actions.
